questions.prompt: As of 2023, what was the average global life expectancy at birth?
questions.insight: Global life expectancy has climbed from about 47 years in 1950 to over 73 years today, despite a dip during the pandemic.

questions.prompt: What percentage of the world's total land area is currently covered by forest?
questions.insight: Despite widespread deforestation concerns, forests still blanket roughly one-third of Earth's land surface.

questions.prompt: What was the world's total nominal GDP (all countries combined, current US dollars) in 2025?
questions.insight: World GDP has more than tripled since 2000, with the US and China alone now generating over 40% of global output.

questions.prompt: In 2024, how many mobile-cellular subscriptions were there per 100 people worldwide?
questions.insight: There are more mobile-cellular subscriptions worldwide than people, since many people hold multiple SIM cards.

questions.prompt: What share of the world's population lived in urban areas in 2024?
questions.insight: Humanity only became majority-urban around 2007; the urban share keeps rising each year.
